meta.title: Blocks — a puzzle without ads
meta.description: Place the pieces, fill rows and columns. No ads, no accounts, no tracking; works offline.

about.title: About
about.text: A puzzle without ads, accounts or tracking. Your records stay on this device. Works offline.
about.keys: Keyboard: 1–3 choose a piece, arrows move it, Enter places it, R turns it, Ctrl+Z takes a move back (calm mode).
